recipes.title: Editorial entrance choreography
recipes.purpose: Introduce a high-value section's actual hierarchy once without withholding meaning
recipes.trigger: Viewport entry after content already rendered
recipes.recipe: Opacity 0.001-to-1 with small translateY 8–18px at 350–600ms; stagger subordinates by 45–80ms; keep heading and CTA readable from first frame
recipes.fallback: Instant display or opacity-only 100ms; no moving essential text
recipes.reject: Fading every paragraph on every scroll; hidden H1 until animation

recipes.title: Meaningful text character reveal
recipes.purpose: Reveal a changed label/status in a technology/terminal context
recipes.trigger: Explicit click to switch semantic content
recipes.recipe: Keep real DOM text in place for accessibility; animate only aria-hidden display duplicate for 300–500ms; final text always matches actual state
recipes.fallback: Set real text immediately and omit decorative overlay
recipes.reject: Perpetual glitch text; scrambling prices or legal terms

recipes.title: ASCII sweep between states
recipes.purpose: Visually distinguish two authored display modes, not hide actual UI
recipes.recipe: Content stays semantic HTML; reversible ASCII overlay follows 400–750ms only in compatible environments; no GPU dependency for interaction
recipes.fallback: CSS opacity swap with instant semantic state change
recipes.reject: Mandatory WebGL; copying Canvas UI source into MIT pack; unreadable text during sweep

recipes.title: Contextual frosted glass refraction
recipes.purpose: Establish layered spatial relationship for navigation or gallery material
recipes.recipe: Use bounded backdrop-filter blur when supported; transition opacity and transform 120–260ms; contrast on translucent panel checked
recipes.fallback: Opaque semantic panel with same focus behavior
recipes.reject: Default 3D glass on every card; invisible contrast; page-wide giant blur

recipes.title: Dissolve and crawl reveal
recipes.purpose: Transition between alternative versions of illustrative text or artwork
recipes.trigger: User requests before/after, version or chapter
recipes.recipe: Clip/mask or small noise dissolve over 250–650ms with stable DOM/focus; original implementation, never imported without checked rights
recipes.fallback: Simple crossfade or instant replacement
recipes.reject: Dissolving form fields while user types; seizure-like flicker

recipes.title: Directional tab and panel change
recipes.purpose: Maintain orientation when switching related information panels
recipes.recipe: Move indicator 130–210ms; panel crossfade up to 220ms; choose direction matching document order and RTL
recipes.fallback: Immediate panel change, static selected indicator
recipes.reject: Tabs that wait on cinematic 2s sweep; no arrow-key access

recipes.title: Tactile button micro-feedback
recipes.purpose: Confirm that a controllable action was received
recipes.recipe: Small scale to 0.97 for 60–110ms then release, only when appropriate; state changes announced semantically
recipes.fallback: Color/outline emphasis with no size change
recipes.reject: Animated button dodges pointer or sends fake success

recipes.title: Task completion and undo
recipes.purpose: Show which list item changed and offer actual recovery
recipes.recipe: Checkbox fill 140ms; row collapse 180–260ms after user sees result; undo toast with keyboard action
recipes.fallback: Instant state change plus text confirmation
recipes.reject: Fake confetti for every task; optimistic remove without rollback

recipes.title: Direct manipulation reorder
recipes.purpose: Maintain object identity while reordering list items
recipes.trigger: Pointer drag or keyboard reorder command
recipes.recipe: Animate displacement 150–220ms after drop; keep drag overlay bounded and pointer-cancel safe
recipes.fallback: Immediate reorder with move up/down buttons
recipes.reject: Physics that shifts items while finger hovers; lost focus

recipes.title: Dialog and drawer motion
recipes.purpose: Establish a new interaction plane and return attention safely
recipes.trigger: User opens dialog or settings drawer
recipes.recipe: Backdrop fade ~150ms, panel translate 140–260ms; focus first meaningful control only after open; restore on close
recipes.fallback: Instant dialog with accessible focus and Escape
recipes.reject: Heavy spring bounce during a destructive confirmation

recipes.title: Scroll-driven editorial chapters
recipes.purpose: Connect sequential evidence or product process without scroll hijacking
recipes.recipe: Small sticky illustration changes keyed to section intersections; content scrolls normally; avoid blocking gestures
recipes.fallback: Linear stacked content with static illustrations and anchors
recipes.reject: Mandatory wheel hijack, pinning that traps touch, decorative perpetual 3D spin

recipes.title: Process or timeline progress
recipes.purpose: Show where the reader or user is inside an ordered flow
recipes.trigger: Scroll progress or explicit step advance
recipes.recipe: SVG line reveal keyed to real position with CSS progress if supported; active step labels retained
recipes.fallback: Static numbered steps and current marker
recipes.reject: Fake percentage unsupported by task progress

recipes.title: Detail view continuity
recipes.purpose: Preserve object identity between a list and a detail screen
recipes.recipe: Matched element transition 180–380ms when platform supports; do not animate layout on huge content
recipes.fallback: Immediate navigation and focus restored on Back
recipes.reject: Massive zoom flying off-screen; reparenting that loses semantic state

recipes.title: Media/gallery transition
recipes.purpose: Help users understand which media item they are examining
recipes.recipe: Crossfade 180–300ms plus controlled image crop; preserve aspect; preload only needed neighbors
recipes.fallback: Instant selected image with alt and location index
recipes.reject: Auto-advancing unpausable carousel; 3D coverflow on mobile controls

recipes.title: Before and after inspection
recipes.purpose: Expose a trustworthy difference through direct manipulation
recipes.recipe: Divider follows pointer directly, no gratuitous inertia; capture two accessible media labels; on release settle <=120ms
recipes.fallback: Side-by-side images with clear labels
recipes.reject: Misleading photos, mouse-only slider, low-res images

recipes.title: Data graphic morph
recipes.purpose: Reveal continuity when legitimate numeric series/filter changes
recipes.trigger: User changes real data filter or time range
recipes.recipe: Interpolate matched data points 220–450ms, coordinate identity retained; label values remain honest and tables available
recipes.fallback: Instant accessible table/chart with selected filter visible
recipes.reject: Counting invented KPIs; animated bars not tied to data

recipes.title: Validation and form state feedback
recipes.purpose: Show when user can recover from bad input or complete action
recipes.recipe: Border/status message change 100–180ms; success only after real confirmation; preserve focus
recipes.fallback: Immediate error text and accessible role/status
recipes.reject: Shaking an entire form; green glow for failed backend save

recipes.title: Upload and processing progress
recipes.purpose: Communicate real work without lying about completion
recipes.trigger: Measured progress or actual server state updates
recipes.recipe: Bar width bound to actual fraction if measurable; indeterminate only when progress unknown; cancel action always visible
recipes.fallback: Text status 'Uploading' or 'Processing' and final server confirmation
recipes.reject: Scripted progress to 99% with no backend; infinite shimmer

recipes.title: Route or view transition
recipes.purpose: Explain navigation context while keeping content fast and accessible
recipes.recipe: Shared backdrop or 140–250ms transition; never block route loader or hide new content on hydration
recipes.fallback: Instant page with correct title/heading and focus
recipes.reject: Full-screen loading intro on every click; inaccessible overlay

recipes.title: Optional pixel character companion
recipes.purpose: Add memorable playful identity only on opted-in playful sites
recipes.trigger: Explicit enable/disable; hover/cursor move on desktop
recipes.recipe: Cursor-follow character with pause, hide, keep-out zones and touch resting behavior; no pointer capture
recipes.fallback: Still decorative character or none for reduced motion/touch
recipes.reject: Tracking user invisibly; covering controls; forced chasing mascot

recipes.title: Magnetic control attention
recipes.purpose: Give a restrained playful feel to a low-stakes isolated action
recipes.trigger: Mouse or stylus hover; keyboard focus stays normal
recipes.recipe: Max 3–6px transform and quick 120ms return; never move interactive hit target away
recipes.fallback: Static hover underline and visible keyboard focus
recipes.reject: Button escapes click; impossible tap target; navigation wobble

recipes.title: Atmospheric particle field
recipes.purpose: Express genuine scientific/artistic material only where it supports identity
recipes.trigger: Optional hero engagement or scroll chapter
recipes.recipe: One canvas contained to decorative region, opacity low, finite duration; pause offscreen; cap DPR and particle count
recipes.fallback: Flat authored SVG/static texture or no decoration
recipes.reject: Sparkles over every section; particles blocking readability

recipes.title: State chip and notification motion
recipes.purpose: Confirm a real system state change clearly
recipes.recipe: Chip color/shape swap 130–220ms with text and aria-live updates, no phantom promise
recipes.fallback: Instant text + icon and persistent status
recipes.reject: Endless pulsing 'syncing' after failure; error hidden in toast
